_doc: Pronunciation fixes, applied to the spoken text only (subtitles keep the original). Keys are whole words, case-sensitive. A [[…]] value is raw IPA (Kokoro, Azure). French: the voice read GitHub as 'ji-hub', Home as 'homme' and spelled GitOps letter by letter. 'HA GitOps' could not be made clear in French with this voice, so the French script says 'GitOps pour Home Assistant'.
